title: Monthly Installment of a New Repayment Plan — Benefit Overpayment Accounts Terms
content:
The monthly installment of a new plan on Benefit Overpayment Accounts is the overpayment's balance divided by the classification's maximum plan months, rounded up to the cent and never less than the classification's minimum monthly payment. The balance is the overpayment's balance due when the plan is set.

## The terms in detail

1. **Balance.** The balance due on the overpayment record on the day the plan is set, across all its components.
2. **Plan months.** The months the balance is divided by are the classification's maximum plan months, as listed in the repayment plan terms. The plan months are never fewer than one.
3. **Rounding.** The quotient is rounded up to the cent: any fraction of a cent raises it to the next whole cent.
4. **Floor.** The installment is never less than the classification's minimum monthly payment, as listed in the repayment plan terms; a rounded quotient below that minimum is replaced by the minimum.

## Examples on hypothetical balances

| Classification (plan terms) | Balance due | Balance divided by plan months | Rounded up | Monthly installment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Agency Error (60 months, minimum USD 25.00) | USD 4,000.00 | 66.6666… | 66.67 | USD 66.67 |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Agency Error (60 months, minimum USD 25.00) | USD 1,234.00 | 20.5666… | 20.57 | USD 25.00 |
| Fraud Overpayment — Repeat Offense (24 months, minimum USD 75.00) | USD 2,000.00 | 83.3333… | 83.34 | USD 83.34 |
